summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of OpenGrox Command Droid. All 11 backend pytest cases passed (health, auth bypass, /command battery UNKNOWN + tts_url, stop VERIFIED, off-topic web UNKNOWN with low on_topic, SMS UNKNOWN, misheard-guard UNKNOWN with low coherent, /connection unreachable, /tts serving audio/mpeg, /register-push, /auth/session 401, /auth/me devops). Frontend cockpit loads at / WITHOUT login. OPENGROX wordmark, 'NO PHONE LINKED' pill, all 5 model chips (GROK/CHATGPT/GEMINI/CLAUDE/AUTO), voice orb 'TAP TO SPEAK', command-input + send-button, model chip switching (color change), typed command 'stop' produces VERIFIED result-card, tapping status-pill navigates to /connect with url-input/token-input/connect-button/account-email/signout-button all visible. Jev screen correctly classifies (on_topic<0.5 for off-topic, coherent<0.35 for garbled input) — playbook criteria met.

issues: 'SIGNED IN AS' shows '—' because AUTH_ENABLED=false leaves useAuth().user null; expected while auth is bypassed but may confuse. Consider showing 'DevOps' placeholder.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow'. Comes from a component (likely VoiceOrb/StatusBadge). Non-blocking but should migrate.
Console warning: props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents. Non-blocking.

action_items: (Optional) On /connect show a friendly placeholder for account email when AUTH_ENABLED=false (currently blank '—').
(Optional) Replace deprecated shadow* style props with boxShadow and props.pointerEvents with style.pointerEvents in RN components to eliminate console warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~780 lines — approaching the 700-line split guideline; consider splitting skills, auth, external integrations into modules.
get_tts returns FileResponse with status_code=404 pointing at a non-existent path — FileResponse will still try to stat the file; prefer explicit Response(status_code=404).
AUTH_REQUIRED default is 'true' in code but .env sets false — correctly bypasses; confirmed.
seed_data_creation: None persisted (tests use TEST_ prefixes only where writes happen; /connection unreachable path does not persist).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base: https://voice-droid-hub.preview.emergentagent.com. Auth is bypassed (AUTH_REQUIRED=false) — /api/command works without Authorization header. Jev live-calls the Emergent LLM (~1-3s latency). Perplexity/Twilio/XAI keys intentionally empty — corresponding skills correctly return UNKNOWN 'not set up' messages. Do NOT attempt real Droid-MCP connection — device commands correctly return UNKNOWN when no phone is linked.
